title: Anthropic cuts its coordinated vulnerability disclosure window from 90 to 30 days for high- and critical-severity issues, in response to AI-driven bug discovery (Anthropic)
summary: Anthropic: Anthropic cuts its coordinated vulnerability disclosure window from 90 to 30 days for high- and critical-severity issues, in response to AI-driven bug discovery — We remain optimistic that this will help defenders find and fix vulnerabilities faster than ever before.
reason: Anthropic's change to its vulnerability disclosure window is a company security-process policy update, not a model release, research artifact, business event (financing/M&A/partnership/market data/product launch), government policy action, or open-source tool release. No active rule covers it.
